The Flyers were led by first-year head coach [[Anthony Grant (basketball)|Anthony Grant]] and played their home games at the [[University of Dayton Arena]] as members of the [[Atlantic 10 Conference]]. They finished the season 14–17, 8–10 in [[2017–18 Atlantic 10 Conference men's basketball season|A-10 play]] to finish in ninth place. They lost in the second round of the [[2018 Atlantic 10 men's basketball tournament|A-10 tournament]] to [[2017–18 VCU Rams men's basketball team|VCU]]. ==Previous season== The [[2016–17 Dayton Flyers men's basketball team|Flyers]] finished the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2016–17 season]] 24–8, 15–3 in [[2016–17 Atlantic 10 Conference men's basketball season|A-10 play]] to win the regular season A-10 championship.
